artworks.title: The Kindliness Came Not from Her
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with a woman in a doorway and three men in the foreground. The woman stands in the doorway, while the three men are engaged in conversation or debate. The room is furnished and decorated, conveying a sense of drama and tension. The style of clothing and decor suggests a historical or period setting.

artworks.title: Lady of 1860 - The Actress
artworks.medium: graphite and charcoal on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image portrays an upper-class woman in a three-quarter view from the left side. She is shown from head to mid-shin, in a profile stance looking down. The woman's facial features are delicately sketched, and her hair is styled with a veil. She wears an intricate gown with an off-the-shoulder design and detailed texture, and holds a bouquet. The background is textured, forming an abstract backdrop against the woman.

artworks.title: Nude Girl Reclining
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The drawing shows a seated woman facing the left, angled slightly away from us. The woman is leaning back, seated on a bed-like surface, with her left arm bent to provide support. Her head is slightly bowed, and her gaze is directed downwards. She has pale skin and short hair styled away from her face. Her facial features are minimal, with a thick black line suggesting her eye. Her upper body is uncovered, with thin curving lines at her waist suggesting a thin skirt or covering. The background is shaded, the left side slightly darker than the right.

artworks.title: Dancing Town (The Top of the World)
artworks.medium: black chalk, pen and brush and black ink, and pen and white ink with scratching out over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a lone figure on a rocky outcrop, looking out over a vast landscape. The figure is on rugged terrain, with clouds or mist nearby. The horizon is high in the composition, with hills and mountains in the distance. Dynamic brushstrokes are used in the land and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, using black, gray, and white tones for contrast and atmosphere.

artworks.title: A Winter Day - Under the Elevated near Brooklyn Bridge
artworks.medium: brush and ink, watercolor and colored crayon
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image displays a series of overlapping lines and forms, with geometric shapes in the central portion resembling an elevated structure. The angular lines and rectangular forms may suggest a bridge or viaduct supported by vertical pillars. Vaguely defined figures below the structure hint at the presence of people or animals, with circular shapes potentially representing wheels or carts, alluding to a busy street or marketplace. The use of dark and muted colors emphasizes the abstract nature of the scene, conveying urban activity and movement.

artworks.title: Woodstock Road, Woodstock, New York
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: Drawn with black crayon on tan-colored paper, a winding road weaves past fields, trees, and a few houses in this horizontal landscape. The road is created with dark, wavy lines that run almost parallel to each other. The road nearly spans the lower edge of the composition, and it curves into the distance. Vegetation to either side is indicated with bouncing squiggles or flicks of the crayon. One house edges into the picture from the right and another is at the foot of rolling hills farther back in the scene. The sky is filled with puffy clouds. The landscape is enclosed with a border made of freehand-drawn lines. Beneath the bottom line and near the right corner, an inscription reads “Geo. Bellows ESB.”

artworks.title: Allan Donn Puts to Sea
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a stormy seascape with a small boat caught in turbulent waves. The composition features a high horizon, churning waves, a stormy sky, and figures struggling in the boat. The brushstrokes are dynamic, focusing on contrast and shading to depict movement. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black, white, and gray. On the right side, a group of people are depicted as onlookers, adding a human element to the scene.

artworks.title: Dempsey and Firpo
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a boxing match. The image shows two boxers fighting in a boxing ring. One boxer is jumping over the fallen opponent. The boxers have muscular forms and the lighting is dramatic. There are ropes in the boxing ring and a crowd of onlookers in the foreground. The composition is dynamic and full of movement. The drawing is in black and white, giving it a classic feel.

artworks.title: Lady with a Fan
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting on a chair. She has a straight posture, legs crossed, hands holding a fan on her lap. She has a detailed face with a calm expression, intricate updo and a grand dress with lace. Large earrings hang next to her face. In the background are drawn curtains, a table with a vase, and furniture.

artworks.title: Lychnis and Her Sons
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This drawing features three nude figures facing away from the viewer, overlooking a vast landscape. The background includes a large body of water, coastal buildings, and towers, creating a historical vibe. Details in the landscape and figures suggest a narrative-driven approach, possibly capturing a moment of contemplation or discussion. The use of monochromatic tones adds to the classic feel of the piece.

artworks.title: Elsie, Emma and Marjorie, second stone
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image displays three women seated on a settee. The women are depicted from the upper body to the knees. The first woman on the left is seated on a chair, turned slightly toward the others, with dark hair styled up and a pale complexion. She wears an elegant gown with a dark bodice and a lighter skirt, and a bracelet adorns her wrist. The second woman, centered and facing forward, has dark hair with bangs and is gazing ahead. She is dressed in a richly detailed gown with ruffles. The third woman, sitting to the right and leaning toward the central figure, has lighter hair styled in an updo with bangs. She wears a light-colored dress with lace details and holds something in her hands. In the background, shadowy figures of other people can be seen standing and likely engaged in conversation. The setting appears to be indoors, with detailed upholstered furniture implying a formal or elegant environment.

artworks.title: Mother and Children
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated, holding a child who is lying across her lap. The woman has dark, straight hair and gentle facial features, wearing a dark dress with a short sleeve. The child has smooth features and fine hair, dressed in light-colored clothing. They are seated on a patterned surface, and behind them is a backdrop of foliage or plants. Above them is a striped canopy, and the background features intricate and textured patterns, possibly representing a garden or outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Preliminaries
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a boxing match in an indoor arena. The focus is on a dimly lit boxing ring with two figures boxing and a referee overseeing them. Surrounding the ring is an audience of elegantly dressed figures, mostly in dark formal attire and top hats. The composition is in a dark monochrome palette, creating a sense of suspense and intensity. The crowd's postures and expressions add depth to the scene, showing an intersection between sport, social gathering, and spectacle.

artworks.title: Sixteen East Gay Street
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image is a street scene viewed from a level perspective. There is a hint of a horizon with streets, buildings, trees, and structures in the distance. It is created using monochromatic tones, likely through lithographic techniques. The fine black and white detailing and shading provide texture to the trees, people, and buildings. The image features a palette of predominantly grays and blacks on a white background. Closest to the viewer, a man stands next to a bicycle while another person bends down, potentially fixing it. Figures are seen chatting on porches and walking along the path in the background, adding to the lively street setting.

artworks.title: Sunday 1897
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows four people in a horse-drawn carriage. All four individuals are visible from head to foot as they sit in the vehicle. The person on the far left is an older man with a beard, wearing a hat and a formal suit, gesturing with his hand. Next to him is a younger man with short hair, wearing a boater hat and a striped suit. Behind them is another older man seated with a slightly hunched posture, holding a document or paper. On the right side sits an older woman dressed in a large, patterned garment with a bonnet, holding a small folding fan. The carriage is covered with a fringed canopy. In the background, two horses are partially visible. The setting includes a picket fence, trees, a house in the distance, and two women standing near the fence on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: Tennis
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a park scene with a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon is high in the image, marked by a line of trees framing the scene, with a cloudy sky visible beyond. The brushstrokes are detailed, providing texture to the trees and figures. The shading is soft, adding depth. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray and black creating contrast between light and shadow. A group of people is gathered, some sitting and others standing, watching or playing tennis. More figures are across the grassy area, engaged in leisure activities. Trees flank the scene, and a structure with arches is visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Tennis
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a park scene with numerous figures engaged in leisure activities. People are sitting or in motion, creating a dynamic atmosphere. The park is surrounded by large trees, offering shaded areas with sunlight filtering through. Some figures hold umbrellas. The drawing captures the play of light and shadow, emphasizing a lively yet relaxed mood.

artworks.title: Studies of Jean
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's head and neck. The main portrait features the individual in a three-quarter profile, looking to the left. They have youthful facial features with long, smooth hair. Surrounding the main portrait are additional sketches showing the lower part of the face and a side profile of an eye and brow. The background is a plain, light-colored paper. There are no accessories or objects depicted in the sketch.

artworks.title: The Cross in the Wilderness
artworks.medium: graphite with gray-green, green-brown, and white chalk on gray paper
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund

artworks.title: Studies for "Washington Crossing the Delaware" [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund

artworks.title: Study of Half-Length Figure with Pole [verso]
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a person's upper body. The individual is leaning forward and appears to be engaging in an activity such as swinging or striking with an elongated tool. Their facial features are lightly outlined, and they have short hair or a tied headband. The attire is simple with long sleeves. The background is plain paper with faint pencil marks.

artworks.title: Shepard Alonzo Mount, Age Twenty-Three [recto]
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a person seated at a table. The individual is leaning forward with their arm resting on the table. They are facing away from the viewer, showing their side profile. The person has medium-length tousled hair covering part of their forehead. They wear a jacket with a high collar and a shirt. Their right hand holds a pen, writing on a piece of paper, while the left hand rests on the table holding the paper. An inkpot is on the table next to the document. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Sketch of a Standing Man [verso]
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image is a sketch on a lightly aged piece of paper, showing a faint full-body outline of a person positioned slightly to the left side of the composition. The person appears to stand upright, but details are not clearly defined. Vague lines suggest the person might be wearing a hat and a long garment, possibly a coat or robe. The facial features are not discernible due to the lightness of the sketch. There is no visible jewelry or objects held by the person. The background of the image is plain, with some visible texture and discoloration likely due to the paper's condition.

artworks.title: Arms of a Boxer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel and Rita Fraad
artworks.description: This image depicts a sketch showing partial views of a human body, focusing on the arms and upper torso. The body is positioned with both arms raised, one bent at the elbow, and the other extending upwards. The head is outlined without detailed features. The drawn lines suggest muscles and definition in the arms but do not depict any clothing or jewelry. The background of the image remains plain.
